comment: The public roadmap. `bun nv site --check roadmap` keeps it in step with the goal chain, and `bun nv site --roadmap` copies it into README.md. `internal` lists the goals that are not public work.

themes.title: Faster starts and faster requests
themes.text: A small program starts without loading what it does not use. Compiled code calls fewer helper functions, and a request waits less. The editor and the type checker do less work for each change.
